plan.scene: Thick dark-grey muddy debris flow surging through a narrow concrete canal / stream under a small road bridge in a green mountain valley. Filmed from a weathered wooden railing / balcony in left foreground overlooking channel. Left bank dense green bushes and trees, right bank white multi-storey buildings with windows, balconies and ground-floor walls very close to channel. Background hazy forested hills/mountains. Daylight, lush monsoon-season vegetation. No vehicles or people clearly visible. Low-resolution vertical phone video with added caption boxes on top.
